evidence_summary: Primary-supported claim: The review identifies a selective association between M2 muscarinic receptors and the GABA-B2 subunit; the cited primary demonstrates direct C-terminal binding, plasma-membrane FRET/TIRF association, cortical co-immunoprecipitation and rescue of M2/GIRK signaling after chronic cholinergic stimulation. Primary model/assay: Rat and mouse neuronal systems, PC12 cells expressing M2R and GABA-B2, recombinant C-terminal domains and adult cortex; FRET/TIRF, protein-overlay binding, co-immunoprecipitation, surface-expression and whole-cell GIRK electrophysiology
limitations: Preserve the selective proximal C-terminal M2R–GABA-B2 association and heteromer/trafficking context; the primary does not establish a universal GABA-B1 interaction or a single shared G-protein mechanism, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference is added.
